Transport Modes

रैचेट स्ट्रैप

A heavy-duty tie-down device with a ratcheting mechanism, used to secure cargo to transport platforms, vehicles, or containers; essential for compliance with cargo securing regulations in road, sea, and air freight.

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

A heavy-duty tie-down device with a ratcheting mechanism, used to secure cargo to transport platforms, vehicles, or containers; essential for compliance with cargo securing regulations in road, sea, and air freight.

Operational example

All cargo on the flatbed truck must be secured with at least two ratchet straps as per EN 12195-2 requirements.
